gen-zen-dots-gf-syncopate: Zen Dots spreads out with a friendly, techy looseness, every letter given plenty of room to breathe. Syncopate draws ruler-straight lines with rope-ladder spacing, and that shared generosity is the pair's best trait.
gen-zen-dots-manrope: Techy and friendly, Zen Dots leaves generous room around every single letter shape. And Manrope keeps a single-width pen line of its own, standing a bit taller in the lowercase.
gen-zen-dots-satoshi: Friendly and techy, Zen Dots gives each letter shape plenty of space around it. Satoshi would carry paragraph after paragraph comfortably, its unsqueezed e and soaring x-height keeping each line open.
gen-zen-dots-work-sans: Techy but friendly, Zen Dots lets every letter breathe with generous openings. Work Sans then settles into a monoweight stroke and high mean line, so long paragraphs would move along smoothly.
gen-zodiak-gf-science-gothic: Science Gothic spaces its stroke ends far apart and holds one constant weight, giving the feeling of reading letter by letter. Zodiak delivers dramatic thick-thin swagger, while the body simply keeps a steady stroke.
gen-zodiak-gf-syncopate: Dramatic swings between fat downstrokes and wispy upstrokes give Zodiak its dignified, authoritative voice, while Syncopate holds one poured width. One performs, the other keeps time with its rope-ladder spacing.
gen-almendra-display-fs-rowan: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display never lets its letters pinch shut. It is built for tall, showy lines, while Rowan, friendlier and slightly finer in its hairlines, handles the quieter text.
gen-almendra-display-gf-almendra: Almendra Display brings ornate, literary letters that never pinch shut and a pronounced x-height, built to make an entrance. Almendra itself is dignified and bookish, its deep midsection made for running text.
gen-almendra-display-gf-bree-serif: Bree Serif reads literary and refined, its lowercase proportions deliberately outsized. Bree Serif would hold up across a full page of text, with Almendra Display above it supplying ornate, open letters.
gen-almendra-display-gf-quando: Almendra Display is ornate and literary, with letters that never pinch shut and a pronounced x-height. Quando brings bookish, traditional spacing, sparse and wide, and that shared openness is what ties the two.
